cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Test the Impossible Claim
cards.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. There's an invisible bridge across this ditch. Tap for it with your umbrella before I cross.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Yours extends. You can test it without leaving the bank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probe. But a surface isn't proof it'll hold you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Slide your picnic basket onto it first. Leave my lunch inside; I want a convincing weight.

mechanism: A directs B's equipment and burden into progressively practical tests before A risks crossing an invisible bridge.
confusable: Unlike merely trusting a bizarre claim, A insists B probe and load it first while A holds decision authority.
comparison: A ditch and picnic-basket load differ from a tap's requested output.
seedUse: The seed already commands probing and then loading, keeping B as tester despite an offered swap.
